newsitem.title: USA: U.S. GSA awards discount contracts to 18 airlines.
newsitem.headline: U.S. GSA awards discount contracts to 18 airlines.

text.p: The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) said Monday it had awarded contracts to 18 airlines for discount rates on more than 6,100 domestic and international routes for federal travelers that are expected to save $2.4 billion during the upcoming fiscal year.
The administration said the new fares are on average 62 percent below unrestricted commercial rates, compared to last year's 56 percent.
He said that the new contract offers 1,000 more routes than the old contracts and that non-stop service will be available in 1,436 markets, up from 1,300 markets under the old contracts.
The one-year contracts, effective October 1, 1996, permit the federal government to take advantage of discounts offered by the airline industry on terms and conditions suitable to government travel.
